name: Zoku Satsuriku no Django -Jigoku no Shoukinkubi-
original_name: 続・殺戮のジャンゴ ─地獄の賞金首─
source:
The planet Sweetwater is a wasteland of burning desert sands, an abandoned utopia of thieves where the usage of galactic technology is strictly forbidden by advanced bio-mechanical lifeforms known as Protozoans who watch over the planet from the skies above. 

Here, a single legend is uttered with equal reverence betwixt the ranks of the corrupt nobility, the downtrodden farming peasants, and the bloodthirsty rogues who make Sweetwater their nest - this is the legend of Black Franco, a gunslinger-cum-revolutionary who managed to amass a hidden fortune, incite a revolution, and earn a 500000 dollar price on his head before vanishing ten years ago.

Recently, however, there have been new rumors of a gunslinger appearing with Franco's trademark gun, the Black Hawk, in hand... Lily Salvatana, a particularly sagacious headhunter, takes it upon herself to claim the massive bounty set on Franco's head. However, Lily soon encounters a mysterious gunslinger who refuses to speak her name who seems to have the same idea - exactly who will end up claiming the bounty? And in the first place, who exactly is Franco?

[Adapted from the [url=http://www.nitroplus.co.jp/pc/lineup/into_13/htmlver/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
甜水星是一片燃烧着沙海的荒原，也是遭人遗弃的盗贼乌托邦。被称为原生体的先进生物机械生命从天空监视着这颗星球，并严格禁止人们使用银河技术。

在这里，无论是腐败贵族、受压迫的农民，还是以甜水星为巢穴的嗜血恶徒，都对同一个传说心怀敬畏——那是关于黑色弗兰科的传说。她既是枪手，也是革命家，曾积累起一笔隐秘财富、煽动革命，并在十年前失踪前被悬赏50万美元。

然而最近，有传闻称一名枪手手持弗兰科的标志性武器“黑鹰”现身。精明过人的赏金猎人莉莉·萨尔瓦塔纳决定亲自取下弗兰科首级，赢得巨额赏金。但莉莉很快遇见了另一名拒绝透露姓名的神秘枪手，对方似乎也抱着同样目的——究竟谁会拿到赏金？更根本的问题是，弗兰科究竟是谁？

[改编自[url=http://www.nitroplus.co.jp/pc/lineup/into_13/htmlver/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
